claims.claim: tag `ep10` 的程式碼還沒有 `telemetry` 套件，也沒有 `observe.go`；整個 `*.go` 裡沒有 `trace_id` 這個字，也沒有任何 `go.opentelemetry.io` 的 import。`ep10` 的 log 用沒有 ctx 的 `logger.Info("request", ...)` 寫出請求紀錄，只有 `method`、`path`、`status`、`duration_ms` 四個欄位，logger 是純 JSON handler。這些都是這一章新增的。
claims.claim_en: The code at tag `ep10` has no `telemetry` package and no `observe.go`, and the word `trace_id` appears in no `*.go` file, nor does any `go.opentelemetry.io` import. `ep10` writes the request log with `logger.Info("request", ...)`, which takes no ctx, with only four fields, `method`, `path`, `status` and `duration_ms`, through a plain JSON handler. All of this is added in this chapter.

claims.claim: 環境變數 `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER` 沒設或設成 `none` 時，`NewTracerProvider` 不接任何 exporter；設成 `stdout` 時，用批次方式把 span 以 JSON 寫到 stderr；其他值回傳錯誤。`main` 在啟動時用 `otel.SetTracerProvider` 把它裝成全域的，並用 `defer` 登記：`main` 結束前，用 5 秒期限的 context 呼叫 `telemetry.Shutdown`，把批次佇列裡的 span 寫出去。測試 `TestStdoutExporterWritesTheSpan` 證明。
claims.claim_en: When `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER` is unset or `none`, `NewTracerProvider` attaches no exporter; with `stdout` it writes spans as JSON to stderr in batches; any other value returns an error. At startup, `main` installs it as the global provider with `otel.SetTracerProvider` and registers a `defer`: before `main` exits, the `defer` calls `telemetry.Shutdown` with a 5-second context to write out the spans in the batch queue. The test `TestStdoutExporterWritesTheSpan` proves this.

claims.claim: `cmd/api/main.go` 用 `otelhttp.NewHandler` 包住整個商店，名稱是 `shop`，所以每個請求在其他中介層之前先開一個 span。`GET /metrics` 掛在同一個 `http.ServeMux` 上、商店旁邊，不經過限流器和 session：限流器與 session 只接在商店的 handler 上，`mux` 建立之後的程式碼不再出現它們。
claims.claim_en: `cmd/api/main.go` wraps the whole shop in `otelhttp.NewHandler`, named `shop`, so every request gets a span before any other middleware runs. `GET /metrics` is registered on the same `http.ServeMux`, beside the shop, outside the rate limiter and the session: both are attached only to the shop handler, and no code after `mux` is created mentions them.

claims.claim: `Checkout` 手動開一個子 span，名稱是 `order.place`，只包住 `s.store.Place`，也就是跟 PostgreSQL 講話的那一段。下單失敗時，span 記錄錯誤並把狀態設成 error。`Place` 回傳後 span 就結束；`Checkout` 後面清購物車仍用原本的 `ctx`，不是 `placeCtx`。資料庫與 Redis 的呼叫沒有各自的 span：`go.mod` 和 `*.go` 裡沒有 `otelpgx`、`redisotel`、`otelsql`。除了測試，`cmd` 與 `internal` 裡只有 `internal/service/order.go` 呼叫 `Tracer(`。
claims.claim_en: `Checkout` opens one hand-made child span named `order.place` around `s.store.Place` only, the part that talks to PostgreSQL. On failure the span records the error and sets its status to error. The span ends once `Place` returns; the cart cleanup after it still uses the original `ctx`, not `placeCtx`. Database and Redis calls have no spans of their own: `go.mod` and `*.go` contain no `otelpgx`, `redisotel` or `otelsql`. Outside tests, only `internal/service/order.go` under `cmd` and `internal` calls `Tracer(`.

claims.claim: `telemetry.NewLogHandler` 回傳的 `slog.Handler` 包住內層 handler。ctx 裡有有效的 span 時，它在每筆紀錄加上 `trace_id` 與 `span_id` 兩個欄位。`WithAttrs` 與 `WithGroup` 也回傳包過的 `logHandler`，所以 `logger.With` 與 `WithGroup` 之後 trace id 還在。把 `WithAttrs` 改成直接回傳內層 handler，測試 `TestLogHandler/survives_logger.With` 就失敗。
claims.claim_en: The `slog.Handler` returned by `telemetry.NewLogHandler` wraps an inner handler. When the ctx carries a valid span, it adds two fields, `trace_id` and `span_id`, to each record. `WithAttrs` and `WithGroup` also return the wrapped `logHandler`, so the trace id survives `logger.With` and `WithGroup`. Changing `WithAttrs` to return the inner handler directly makes the test `TestLogHandler/survives_logger.With` fail.

checks.pattern: func \(h logHandler\) WithAttrs\(attrs \[\]slog.Attr\) slog.Handler \{\n\treturn logHandler\{inner: h.inner.WithAttrs\(attrs\)\}
func \(h logHandler\) WithGroup\(name string\) slog.Handler \{\n\treturn logHandler\{inner: h.inner.WithGroup\(name\)\}

claims.claim: 沒有 ctx 的 `logger.Info` 寫出來的紀錄沒有 trace id，測試 `TestLogHandler/plain_Info_has_no_context_to_read` 重現。這一章把請求紀錄、`writeError` 的失敗原因、`Recover` 的 panic 紀錄、金流回呼的兩筆紀錄，以及下單後清購物車的警告，都改成帶 ctx 的 `InfoContext`、`ErrorContext`、`WarnContext`。
claims.claim_en: A plain `logger.Info` call, with no ctx, writes a record without a trace id; the test `TestLogHandler/plain_Info_has_no_context_to_read` replays it. This chapter switches the request log, the failure reason in `writeError`, the panic record in `Recover`, the two payment-callback records, and the warning when the cart is not emptied after an order to the ctx-taking `InfoContext`, `ErrorContext` and `WarnContext`.

checks.text: s.logger.WarnContext(ctx, "order placed but cart not emptied"

claims.claim: `telemetry.NewMetrics` 在自己的 Prometheus registry 加兩個 HTTP 指標：計數器 `http_requests_total`，標籤是 `method`、`route`、`status`；直方圖 `http_request_duration_seconds`，標籤是 `method`、`route`。`Metrics.Handler` 提供 Prometheus 抓取用的文字格式。測試 `TestMetricsObserve` 證明。
claims.claim_en: `telemetry.NewMetrics` adds two HTTP metrics to its own Prometheus registry: the counter `http_requests_total` with labels `method`, `route`, `status`, and the histogram `http_request_duration_seconds` with labels `method`, `route`. `Metrics.Handler` serves the text format Prometheus scrapes. The test `TestMetricsObserve` proves it.

claims.claim: `Instrument` 用 chi 比對到的路由樣式（例如 `/products/{id}`）當 `route` 標籤，不用原始路徑，而且在 `next.ServeHTTP` 跑完之後才讀。沒有路由認領的請求，以及 `Mount` 產生的 `/*`，標籤都是 `unmatched`。測試 `TestMetricsExposeTheRoutePatternNotThePath` 打 `/products/1`、`/products/2` 各一次和一次不存在的路徑：`/products/{id}` 的次數是 2，`unmatched` 的 404 次數是 1，`/metrics` 輸出裡沒有原始路徑。
claims.claim_en: `Instrument` uses the route pattern chi matched (for example `/products/{id}`) as the `route` label, never the raw path, and reads it after `next.ServeHTTP` has finished. Requests no route claimed, and the `/*` that `Mount` creates, are labelled `unmatched`. The test `TestMetricsExposeTheRoutePatternNotThePath` requests `/products/1` and `/products/2` once each plus one unknown path: `/products/{id}` counts 2, `unmatched` counts one 404, and the `/metrics` output holds no raw path.

claims.claim: `main` 把 `Instrument` 排在限流器前面，所以被限流的 429 也計數，標籤是 `unmatched`。`Instrument` 用 `defer` 計數，handler panic 時記成 500。測試 `TestMetricsCountRateLimitedAndPanickedRequests` 證明這兩種情況都進得了 `/metrics`。
claims.claim_en: `main` puts `Instrument` before the rate limiter, so a rate-limited 429 is counted, labelled `unmatched`. `Instrument` counts in a `defer`, and records a handler panic as 500. The test `TestMetricsCountRateLimitedAndPanickedRequests` proves both reach `/metrics`.

checks.text: handler.Instrument(metrics), // before the limiter, so a 429 is counted too

claims.claim: 測試 `TestRequestLogCarriesTheTraceID` 用跟 `main` 同樣的層次：最外層 `otelhttp`，裡面是路由、`RequestLog`、`Instrument`。它打一個 `GET /products/1`，解析那一行 log：`trace_id` 等於 handler 自己從 ctx 讀到的 trace id，而且有 `span_id`。
claims.claim_en: The test `TestRequestLogCarriesTheTraceID` uses the same layering as `main`: `otelhttp` outermost, then the router, `RequestLog` and `Instrument`. It sends one `GET /products/1` and parses the log line: `trace_id` equals the trace id the handler itself reads from the ctx, and `span_id` is present.

claims.claim: 測試 `TestCheckout_RecordsAChildSpan` 證明 `order.place` 是請求 span 的子 span；下單成功時狀態不是 error，`store_fails` 情況下狀態是 error。
claims.claim_en: The test `TestCheckout_RecordsAChildSpan` proves `order.place` is a child of the request span; its status is not error on success and is error in the `store_fails` case.

claims.claim: Java 的 `ThreadLocal` 把值綁在執行緒上，每條執行緒讀到自己的那一份。Go 沒有這種綁定，值放在 `context.Context`，明確傳給每一個需要它的函式，慣例是放第一個參數。
claims.claim_en: Java `ThreadLocal` binds a value to a thread: each thread reads its own copy. Go has no such binding; the value lives in a `context.Context` that is passed explicitly to each function that needs it, by convention as the first parameter.
